name: plate_settings
label: Hex Plate
description: Tune the JustinSDK hexagon plate before it is extruded in JSCAD

name: hex_radius
description: Hexagon radius used by the base lattice

name: hex_spacing
description: Spacing between hex cells in the base lattice

name: hex_count
description: Number of concentric hexagon rings in the plate

name: plate_height
description: Extrusion height of the hex plate

name: crown_settings
label: Starburst Crown
description: Optional JustinSDK starburst centerpiece layered on top of the plate

name: crown_outer_radius
description: Outer radius of the starburst crown

name: crown_inner_radius
description: Inner radius of the starburst crown

name: crown_points
description: Point count used by the JustinSDK starburst helper

name: crown_height
description: Height parameter for the starburst crown

name: crown_spin_deg
description: Rotate the starburst crown in place
